data.body_html:
The Sotogrande Polo Final 2026 is one of the Costa del Sol’s most glamorous summer events, drawing international crowds to the lush fields of Sotogrande. For the ultimate experience, combine world-class polo with a Marbella yacht charter from Puerto Banús. Arrive in style, enjoy the Mediterranean views, and make the most of your day on the water before or after the matches. Our fleet offers everything from compact speedboats to superyachts, with packages starting at €749 for two hours. Whether you want a quick cruise or a full-day luxury charter, we have the perfect boat for your group.

Why charter a yacht for the Sotogrande Polo Final?

Attending the polo final is about more than the match — it’s a social affair. A private yacht from Puerto Banús adds a layer of exclusivity and convenience. You can anchor near the Sotogrande coast, enjoy lunch on deck, and then take a tender to the polo club. The short 15-minute cruise from Puerto Banús means you spend less time travelling and more time enjoying the event. Plus, you avoid the traffic that clogs the coastal roads during major events.

Our recommended yacht packages for the polo final

We’ve curated two tiers of packages that work perfectly for the Sotogrande Polo Final. All depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT.

For larger groups or specific preferences, we also offer the Azimut 58 Flybridge, Ferretti 94, and other yachts — pricing on request via WhatsApp. The Mangusta 80 package includes a free jet ski, adding extra fun to your day.

What to expect on the day

Your charter begins at Puerto Banús, where you’ll meet your skipper. After a safety briefing, you’ll cruise south along the coast, passing the Golden Mile and the Marbella Marina. Keep an eye out for La Concha mountain in the background. You can stop for a swim at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés before heading to Sotogrande. The polo final typically runs from late afternoon into the evening, so plan your charter to include a leisurely lunch onboard. After the match, return to Puerto Banús for dinner at one of the harbour’s top restaurants.

Fleet highlights for polo final charters

Our fleet includes a range of vessels suitable for different group sizes and budgets. The Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are ideal for smaller groups wanting a cost-effective option. For a more luxurious experience, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) offers ample deck space, a flybridge, and a jet ski. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) combines comfort with performance. If you’re celebrating with a large party, the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) provides true superyacht amenities. All boats are maintained to the highest standards and skippered by experienced professionals.

How to book your Marbella yacht charter for the polo final

Booking is simple. Contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and budget. We’ll confirm availability and send you a quote. For the Sotogrande Polo Final, early booking is essential — popular yachts like the Mangusta 80 and Azimut 58 are often reserved weeks in advance. Once booked, we’ll coordinate the departure time and any special requests, such as catering or a specific itinerary. Your skipper will be in touch the day before to finalise details.

Frequently asked questions

How do I get from Marbella to the Sotogrande Polo Final by boat?

Charter a yacht from Puerto Banús, and you can cruise directly to the Sotogrande marina or anchor near the polo fields. The journey takes about 15–20 minutes by motor yacht. We'll arrange a tender for shore access if needed.

For groups up to 12, the Mangusta 80 (24m) or Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m) offer spacious decks and luxury amenities. For smaller groups, the Azimut 39 (11 pax) is a popular choice. All depart from Puerto Banús.

Are food and drinks included in the yacht charter?

Yes, every charter includes a selection of soft drinks, water, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. You can also bring your own food or arrange catering via our team. The skipper handles all logistics.
